review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form and close the ordinary cumulative revision cycle. R97 contains a careful method-neutral certification result and an unusually transparent negative acquisition experiment, but it does not establish an Econometrica-level neural-specific numerical contribution, a sufficiently broad information-complexity advance, or a consequential economic application.

review_manifest.json.description: Pinned scope, evidence identities, findings, limitations and write policy; deliberately omits its own Git identity

positive_findings: R97 is the strongest source-bound and failure-preserving release in the sequence.
The deterministic adaptive value-query lower-bound proof is credible under its stated univariate convex-Lipschitz fixed-AVaR assumptions.
The exact oblique-ridge approximation calculations and the workload-consistent purchase identity are correct under their written assumptions.
The validate-and-retain construction prevents a numerical optimizer from obtaining certificate authority.
The prospective 84-configuration campaign retains every representation, candidate, rejection, repair and adverse reversal.
The manuscript preserves the R96 quadratic winner and all zero-crossing policy-cost intervals rather than relabeling them as neural wins.
The independent proposal replay, exact statistics and rational endpoint checks materially strengthen the audit boundary.
blocking_findings: The central validity, risk, information and fallback results are method-neutral; the specifically neural contribution is not identified.
The information theorem is a deterministic point-value, univariate, uniform-law, fixed-risk-level result and does not establish broad continuous-risk Bellman complexity.
The oblique-ridge proposition is an approximation example rather than an action-loss, service-work or policy-regret separation.
Certificate-aware fitting improves validated residual span in all 36 matched cells but increases aggregate proposal rejections from 644 to 757.
Quadratic least squares remains the complete-work and operation-count winner at both reported risk levels.
No learned or certificate-aware service is classified adopted over quadratic least squares anywhere in the 1,800-cell conditional price grid.
The newly fitted 84 actors do not receive direct population policy-cost inference; retained R96 intervals belong to different frozen actors.
The independent implementation does not reproduce feature selection, interval-aware fitting, rounding and whole-domain validation.
The active submission remains disproportionate to the narrow current theorem and negative acquisition experiment.
The most compelling new result is certificate-to-decision misalignment, not the broader Neural Bellman Operators platform claim.
required_changes_for_new_submission: Recast the paper around a method-neutral certified recursive-risk computation question.
Map the information theorem precisely to information-based-complexity literature and either broaden it or narrow the claim.
Develop and validate an action-aligned acquisition objective controlling rejection, endpoint work or policy-cost resolution.
Expand the conventional comparator frontier to oblique hinges, convex regression and adaptive geometric methods.
Treat the adverse certificate-to-decision result as first-class evidence.
Execute an economically calibrated application or narrow the paper to numerical certification.
Add a longer-horizon, multiple-control, multiple-innovation continuous-risk scaling experiment.
Strengthen timing design and prioritize machine-independent operation counts.
Independently reimplement fitting and provide a standalone executable artifact.
Shorten the active submission and move historical development to an archival companion.
limitations: The reviewer did not refit models, rerun the Bellman campaign or create new economic observations.
The mathematical check is referee-level rather than a formal proof-assistant verification of every inherited statement.
Observed process clocks are descriptive and do not identify a future-hardware sampling distribution.
The independent implementation covers proposal and endpoint logic but not the fitting optimizer and complete acquisition stack.
The downloadable artifact omits some inherited repository dependencies needed to execute all tests in isolation.
This advisory report is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
